When your city becomes the hunting ground for ghosts and monsters... "Knock, knock." Someone's knocking on your door...

"Shh, don't make a sound, and don't open the door."

Creatures from age-old tales and urban legends are trying to break into your house. Your job? Close the door and defend it with your heroes as your heart pounds with excitement and no fear.
